info.title: Queue OpenAPI for openai/gpt-image-2.5/sunburst/edit
info.description: The OpenAPI schema for the openai/gpt-image-2.5/sunburst/edit queue.

x-fal-metadata.about: Edit images with the selected GPT Image 2.5 model.

GptImage25SunburstEditInput.description: GPT Image 2.5 edit inputs with model-specific quality and compression.

image_urls.description: The URLs of the images to use as a reference for the generation. A maximum of 16 images are allowed.
image_urls.title: Image URLs

mask_url.description: The URL of the mask image to use for the generation. This indicates what part of the image to edit.
mask_url.title: Mask URL

enable_safety_checker.description: Authorized callers may set false to request relaxed screening.
enable_safety_checker.title: Enable Safety Checker

image_size.description: The size of the generated image. Use 'auto' to infer from input images.
image_size.title: Image Size

quality.description: Quality for the generated image. Higher settings increase detail, latency, and token usage. Use 'auto' to let the model choose.
quality.title: Quality

output_compression.description: Compression level from 0 to 100. Only supported when output_format is 'jpeg' or 'webp'.
output_compression.title: Output Compression

sync_mode.description: If `True`, the media will be returned as a data URI and the output data won't be available in the request history.
sync_mode.title: Sync Mode

examples: Same workers, same beam, same lunch boxes - but they're all on their phones now. One is taking a selfie. One is on a call looking annoyed. Same danger, new priorities. A hard hat has AirPods.
prompt.title: Prompt

GptImage25SunburstEditInput.title: GPTImage25EditImageRequest

width.description: The width of the generated image.
width.title: Width

height.description: The height of the generated image.
height.title: Height

content_type.description: The mime type of the file.
content_type.title: Content Type

file_size.description: The size of the file in bytes.
file_size.title: File Size

url.description: The URL where the file can be downloaded from.
url.title: Url

file_name.description: The name of the file. It will be auto-generated if not provided.
file_name.title: File Name

schema.description: Whether to include logs (`1`) in the response or not (`0`).

success.description: Whether the request was cancelled successfully.
